description: Searches for subscriptions using Stripe's Search Query Language. Use when you need to find subscriptions by status, metadata, created timestamp, or canceled_at timestamp.

inputSchema.description: Request model for searching subscriptions in Stripe.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (default is 10, max is 100).
limit.title: Limit

page.description: Pagination cursor for a specific page; omit for the first page. Use `next_page` from a previous response for subsequent pages.
page.title: Page

query.description: The search query string using Stripe's Search Query Language. Supported search fields for subscriptions: status (e.g., 'active', 'canceled'), metadata (custom key-value pairs), created (Unix timestamp), canceled_at (Unix timestamp). Supports exact matches, range queries (>, <, >=, <=), and boolean operators (AND, OR). For detailed syntax, refer to https://docs.stripe.com/search#search-query-language.
query.title: Query
